items.name: utils
items.title: cn()
items.description: clsx + tailwind-merge, with the merger taught Grana's extra font sizes (text-2xs, text-13, text-metric). Replaces the stock utils.

items.name: theme
items.title: Grana theme
items.description: The Grana token layer: palette, semantic slots per surface, brand overrides, the Tailwind theme and base. Import styles/grana.css as the Tailwind entry; set data-brand and data-surface on <html>; copy public/fonts.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The verb: one ink primary per screen, quiet hairlines for the rest, the two-rung destructive ladder, pressed, icon sizes; marketing on-dark and glass. Always a pill, one height per size.

items.name: back-link
items.title: BackLink
items.description: The way back up: a faint inline line above a detail page, or the padded nav row of the shell takeover.

items.name: segmented
items.title: Segmented
items.description: One-of-N that filters, never navigates: the raised pill track (Luminars) or the boxed hairline group (RF), with counts in num.

items.name: filter-chip
items.title: FilterChip
items.description: A pressable pill for a dynamic, wrapping, many-of-many set; selected is aria-pressed, an optional count in num.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state pill: borderless with a hover fill, or outlined; pressed takes the deeper canvas tint.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: ToggleGroup
items.description: A row or column of Toggles sharing one pressed state; spacing 0 joins them into one pill track.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key: mono 10px on the sunken fill inside a hairline, 4px radius.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Portalled, fixed, hoverable: 180 ms open / 120 ms close, closes on any scroll; the popover ground with a hairline and shadow-panel.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The trail above a detail page: 13px secondary text, the current page in ink, faint chevrons.

items.name: prose
items.title: Prose
items.description: Rendered markdown, dressed: sans medium headings, mono code on the sunken fill, a 2px blockquote rule, hairline table rows, quiet underlined links. sm (the rail) · md (the run report) · lg (the serif reading column).

items.name: executor-chip
items.title: ExecutorChip
items.description: Who performs a step — agent (dashed: an inferred AI step) · human · api · screen · wait — in the executor hues; a pill with the soft fill, the hue as text, a 30% hairline. The hues collapse to stone under RF.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: The field shell: 34px, hairline, bg-card, 13px; `mono` for keys, ids and times; `variant="search"` for the sunken topbar search.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: The field shell on a textarea: resize-none, 1.5 line-height, sizes to its content from a 72px floor.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native select
items.description: Luminars' Select: the OS popup on purpose, the field shell with an SVG caret. The default select for the desktop app.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: The custom-popup select (Base UI): trigger = the field shell with a ChevronsUpDown caret; popup = the menu panel, portalled, with eyebrow group labels.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A 16px box: hairline when off, ink when on or indeterminate; no brand hue.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A 30×18 track (24×14 sm): sunken hairline track when off, ink when on; no brand hue.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The field label: sans 500 at 13px; dims with a disabled peer.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: RF `.field` + `.form-error` on the Luminars shell: Field / FieldLabel / FieldDescription / FieldError (+ FieldSet, FieldLegend, FieldGroup, FieldSeparator, FieldContent, FieldTitle).

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input group
items.description: The field shell drawn on a group so an icon, a unit, a kbd or a quiet button sits inside the hairline; `variant="search"` = RF `.search` with its ⌘K kbd.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: The ⌘K palette on cmdk: the menu panel with a search row, eyebrow group headings, accent-highlighted items and mono shortcuts; CommandDialog mounts it in a Dialog.

items.name: code-field
items.title: Code field
items.description: One box per character of a one-time code: type advances, backspace retreats, paste fills all, the last box completes. A paste that is not a code (a sign-in link, a token) is handed back to the caller instead of dropped.

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: The page skeleton on paper: the section rhythm and the 1280 field measure.

items.name: canvas
items.title: Canvas
items.description: Every image on the site: texture, legibility wash, grain, content, registration marks.

items.name: panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: The product framed on paper (Panel) and the neutral card it sits beside (Plot).

items.name: reveal
items.title: RevealObserver
items.description: The scroll-entrance driver: the js gate, [data-reveal] observation, reduced-motion bypass.

items.name: count-up
items.title: CountUp
items.description: A metric that counts to its value once, in Italian grouping, and never re-runs.

items.name: logo-mark
items.title: LogoMark
items.description: The wordmark lockup: the mark tile and the name, at three scales.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: The home field: full-bleed texture, the display line, the stakes pinned to the edge.

items.name: page-hero
items.title: PageHero
items.description: The inner-page head: a framed canvas, eyebrow, title, lead, actions and facts.

items.name: rising-panel
items.title: RisingPanel
items.description: The product rising into the fold under the hero, with its caption.

items.name: product-shot
items.title: ProductShot
items.description: The app, drawn — the tenant dashboard as a static picture, not a screenshot.

items.name: float-panel
items.title: FloatPanel
items.description: The small panel that floats over a canvas, carrying one fragment of the product.

items.name: snippets
items.title: Snippets
items.description: Seven product fragments for a float panel: rows, chat, chart, checklist, browser, quote, review.

items.name: shots
items.title: Shots
items.description: Eleven more product fragments: pipeline, timeline, score, compare, form, call, alert, stats, split, result, variants.

items.name: illustration-card
items.title: IllustrationCard
items.description: A canvas with a floating fragment above it and a title/body under it.

items.name: proof-band
items.title: ProofBand
items.description: The numbers strip under the hero: four metrics between hairlines, no decoration.

items.name: way-card
items.title: WayCard
items.description: One of the ways to work with us: a tinted canvas, a floating snippet, the promise under it.

items.name: modules-grid
items.title: ModulesGrid
items.description: The module map: a hairline grid of cells, each carrying its live / beta / soon state.

items.name: dark-band
items.title: DarkBand
items.description: The dark punctuation: one band per page, image behind, the manifesto on it.

items.name: unit-card
items.title: UnitCard
items.description: One business unit: a duotone canvas in the unit tint and the lockup under it.

items.name: post-card
items.title: PostCard
items.description: An article, a guide or a tool as a card: editorial texture, title, meta, verified line.

items.name: case-study-block
items.title: CaseStudyBlock
items.description: A result told twice: the headline metric with its quote, and the before/after table.

items.name: consult-band
items.title: ConsultBand
items.description: The consulting offer band: the head, the steps, the note and the two verbs.

items.name: tailor-band
items.title: TailorBand
items.description: The tailoring promise: numbered steps between hairlines, the note, the actions.

items.name: cta-band
items.title: CtaBand
items.description: The closing band: a full-bleed canvas, one question, two verbs.

items.name: page
items.title: Page + PageHead
items.description: The content-panel page (narrow 760 · medium 860 · wide 1080 · full; three padding steps) and its header: a font-voice title, a tabular subtitle, one primary action.

items.name: eyebrow
items.title: Eyebrow + SectionHead
items.description: The ALL-CAPS section label in two registers: mono (the eyebrow utility, on one size scale xs·sm·md·lg, with the numbered-index and unit-tint forms) and nav (the lighter sans sidebar group label). SectionHead is the marketing eyebrow + display h2 + lead.

items.name: stat
items.title: StatGrid + Stat
items.description: The KPI row: hairline-gap cells or gap-12 cards, columns fixed or container-fitted. A Stat speaks in the dashboard register (mono caps, fluid metric) or the product one (a plain sans label, a fixed 29px figure). Null is a dash, never a zero.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Drawn charts, no library: hairline-gridline columns (stacked or grouped) with a mono value axis, a 9px-square legend, and a KPI sparkline. Ink by default; chart slots only when a legend must tell series apart. Every chart also renders its numbers as a visually-hidden table.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: The generic empty surface: plain (a centred faint line) or card (the sunken Notice that reports a condition the person did not cause).

items.name: context-band
items.title: ContextBand
items.description: A live state and its one recovery in one shape for every state: a status mark, the state in words, what it means now, and the single lever that changes it.

items.name: teaching-empty
items.title: TeachingEmpty
items.description: The first-visit empty state that teaches: eyebrow, a font-voice title, one paragraph, exactly one primary action — and an optional cropped media column with a dotted ground and a dim (ghost) variant.

items.name: first-visit
items.title: FirstVisit
items.description: The dismissible first-visit panel: inline, never modal, remembered in localStorage; the dismiss is a quiet xs Button.

items.name: term
items.title: Term
items.description: A word of art with its plain explanation one hover/focus away: a small mono ? trails the word; tabIndex 0, always-present sr description, 180/120 ms on the Tooltip.

items.name: feed
items.title: Feed + FeedItem
items.description: The activity feed: actor + sentence + mono time. Humans are round avatars with initials; machines are dashed square tiles with a dashed badge after the sentence.

items.name: tenant-badge
items.title: TenantBadge + TenantTile
items.description: The tenant identity row: a 28px ink tile with initials or logo, the name, a meta line.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: A numbered instruction list: a real <ol> with CSS-counter numerals, so steps renumber themselves. `tone="inverse"` for a panel over a dark or photographic ground.

items.name: step-dots
items.title: StepDots
items.description: The stepper for a multi-step modal footer: 5px dots, the current one a 17px ink bar. The position is named by the caller.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: StatusDot
items.description: A status dot: 7px (6 inside a Chip), six tones, optional live pulse, optional accessible label. Always beside a word.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: A status the thing is in: dot + word, six tones. Outline (the Luminars pill), tinted (the RF 12% fill with an 11px glyph) or status (the same fill at pill radius, dot in the text's ink).

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A property of the thing — its grade, its author — in mono caps. outline · dashed (inferred, not asserted) · ink · tag · action.

items.name: notice
items.title: Notice
items.description: A condition the person did not cause — offline, degraded, nothing yet — stated calmly, with at most one action. card (Luminars) or plain (RF empty).

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline message about something that just happened (role=alert): hairline on the card ground, a leading icon or StatusDot, default or destructive.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A human (round, initials) or a machine (square dashed tile) — the actor contract. outline (Luminars) or filled (RF); xs sm md lg; image, badge, group.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A breathing stone-200 placeholder, shaped by className.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Indeterminate work in progress; inherits the text colour, 16px by default.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Determinate progress: a 2px stone track, an ink bar, a num readout. Never a brand or status hue.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Toaster
items.description: Toasts on sonner: a popover-ground hairline card with shadow-panel, chip-tone dots for the types, and notify() which stamps a mono time.

items.name: orb
items.title: Orb
items.description: The assistant's state indicator: one breathing sphere whose surface is a mesh of five conic wedges orbiting behind a blur. Colour says which state, motion says whether anything is running; --orb-level is the single runtime input.

items.name: mic-meter
items.title: MicMeter
items.description: A ten-bar live microphone meter with fixed per-bar weights, so the same level always draws the same picture. Muted goes flat and quiet.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: The surface box: white, hairline, 10px radius. padded (Luminars) or a frame whose children own the edges; CardHeader is the RF PanelHead (500 title · mono context · hairline).

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: The calm list: 13.5px, hairline rows, mono-caps head; headerFill / hover / minWidth for the RF .data look, bleed / rowHeight / align from Luminars; data-num or the num prop for numeric columns.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: The Luminars Menu recipe on Base UI's Menu: portalled, fixed-safe, hairline + panel shadow, 13px items with the accent highlight, mono shortcuts, a destructive item.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal frame: card ground, strong hairline, 14px radius, panel shadow, a warm-ink veil.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A side-anchored panel with the Dialog's surface language; four sides.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A non-modal anchored layer with the Menu panel's skin and room for prose.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: A scrolling region with a quiet overlay scrollbar.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: The 1px hairline, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: An unstyled disclosure: the caller composes the trigger and the panel.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Underline tabs (default): quiet labels on a hairline, the active one in ink with an ink underline; a filled pill strip as variant=default.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: The list row primitive: media · title/description · actions; hairline-divided rows in an ItemGroup.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: The nav chrome: transparent on the canvas, width from the brand token, eyebrow group labels, 13px rows with the sidebar-active + inset-ring active recipe, mono counts; SidebarInset is the inset content card.

items.name: use-mobile
items.title: useIsMobile
items.description: A matchMedia hook for the sidebar's mobile sheet (below 768px).
